title: Proximal Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Methods for Composite Optimization
summary: The nonlinear conjugate gradient methods are known to be an effective approach for standard unconstrained optimization problems especially for large-scale problems.This paper proposes a proximal nonlinear conjugate gradient method, which extends the nonlinear conjugate gradient methods to composite objective functions, namely, the sum of a smooth nonconvex function and a nonsmooth convex function, and its extension to the case where the nonsmooth function is weakly convex.
